title: Release A, package 4, part 2: the labels on the screens
problem: Release 1.20.0 rewrote the text of the cards, the story, the tutorial and How to play. The labels on the screens are untouched: about 200 audit entries remain in screen files, and the helpers who rebuilt the screens invented about 150 labels and sentences that nobody has checked against the glossary. The same thing is not always called the same word.
scope: The audit's remaining entries applied where the text still exists in the rebuilt screens
Every label invented while rebuilding the screens checked against the glossary and DEC-087: kept, shortened or reworded; one word for one thing on every screen
The wording faults noted by the builders: the stale buying tip, "No peeking!", quotes around quips and customer words, the app's description
Part 1's loose ends: the full list of all 575 entries, the before-and-after samples and the unsure Malaysian wording for the owner
A list of where RULES.md now differs in wording from the cards, for the owner to decide
exclusions: Any layout, rule, number or id
The stamp book's screens (their text is applied with PLAN-086)
